name: GaN Tersoff (Nord-Albe-Erhart-Nordlund 2003)
validity_notes: Bond-order Tersoff for wurtzite & zinc-blende GaN; good general-purpose choice for structure, thermal displacements and point/line defects. No long-range Coulomb -> does not reproduce LO/TO phonon splitting. Shipped with LAMMPS (contributor X. Zhou, Sandia).
citation: J. Nord, K. Albe, P. Erhart, K. Nordlund, J. Phys.: Condens. Matter 15, 5649 (2003). DOI:10.1088/0953-8984/15/32/324
source_note: Copied verbatim from the local LAMMPS 15Jun2023 distribution (Potentials/GaN.tersoff).
